    Read mask¶

    rn_forge.web.read_mask ¶

    The readMask query parameter: partial responses (AIP-157).

    READ_MASK_PARAM = 'readMask' module-attribute ¶

    The name of the query parameter that carries the mask.

    FieldTree = Mapping[str, FieldTree | None] ¶

    The declared shape of a representation, by wire field name.

    A declared object, or a list of declared objects, maps to a subtree. Every other field maps to None, including a free-form JSON value.

    ReadMask(tree) dataclass ¶

    A validated, merged set of field paths.

    tree maps each selected wire field name to a subtree of selected sub-fields, or to None when the whole value is selected.

    apply(body) ¶

    Return a copy of body holding only the selected fields.

    A path through a list applies to every element. A selected field that body lacks is not added.

    parse_read_mask(raw, *, fields) ¶

    Parse a readMask value against the declared fields of a representation.

    Paths are comma-separated and joined by .; whitespace around a path is ignored. Overlapping paths merge, so address and address.city select the whole address.

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    raw str | None

    The raw query value.

    		 required
    fields FieldTree

    The declared shape of the representation.

    		 required

    Returns:

    Type Description
    ReadMask | None

    None when raw is absent, blank or *: the whole representation.

    Raises:

    Type Description
    InvalidReadMask

    * is combined with other paths, or a path is empty or names no declared field, including one that goes inside a scalar or free-form field.
